title: SvgFeDisplacementMap
responsibility: Renders the native feDisplacementMap element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeDisplacementMap.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native element when it is supplied. When omitted, no child snippet is rendered.

outputs.name: SvgFeDisplacementMap
outputs.description: A native SVG feDisplacementMap element with the remaining props spread onto it as attributes. If children is supplied, its snippet is rendered inside the element; no wrapper element is added.
